error.name: Error
error.description: One-hit KO moves always land. All damage taken from moves is fixed at 1 (status effect damage is unaffected and keeps scaling normally off max HP).

singularity.name: Singularity
singularity.description: While the field is under an Event Horizon, raises 6 battle stats (Attack/Defense/Sp. Atk/Sp. Def/Speed/Accuracy) by 2 stages upon entering battle.

eventHorizon.name: Event Horizon
eventHorizon.description: Opens an Event Horizon on entering battle. While it's up, neither side can flee or switch, and any Pokemon entering the field has its Speed lowered by 1 stage.
